variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd with grand words, wants the Ashwood wolves killed; pays with a minstrel's bow and sends the player to Halvard.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text: Greetings, kind sir. I am beset by wolves! Each night they descend out of the Ashwood upon my poor flock, and I am far too old to repel such abominable creatures myself. Would you venture into the wood and exterminate the beasts? I shall reward you handsomely.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Another ewe taken last night! Please, make haste!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
The wolves are gone from the Ashwood? Splendid! Splendid! My flock is liberated at last!

Please, take my old bow and quiver. I purchased the bow from a traveling minstrel who swore it once belonged to a king. I have never hit a thing with it. Now, if you are seeking more honest work, go and see Reeve Halvard in the Moot Hall.

journal.text: Kill the wolves that prey on Ulric's sheep.

variants.specifics: Bormunt: Ulbo the lamplighter, bitten, wants the Giant Leeches of the flooded gallery destroyed; pays with a bow found beside a skeleton and sends the player to Brannoc.

offer.speaker: Ulbo
offer.text:
Sir! Over here! Help me, please! I've been bitten and I can hardly stand!

Abominable Giant Leeches have infested the flooded gallery below the old pump house, south of here. They fell upon me as I was lighting the lamps. Their infestation imperils the entire lower mine, and no miner dares set foot down there now. If you would exterminate these loathsome creatures, I will see you suitably rewarded. Will you do it?

reminder.speaker: Ulbo
reminder.text: Please, sir, hurry! I can still feel them on me...

completion.speaker: Ulbo
completion.text:
You've destroyed them?! Splendid! Splendid!

Take this bow. It was found lying beside an old skeleton in the lower shafts, and nobody ever came to claim it. It's yours now. Guildmaster Brannoc is asking for you at the Guild Hall.

journal.text: Destroy the Giant Leeches in the flooded gallery.

variants.specifics: Oskry: Hobb, a gruff eel fisherman, wants the Giant Leeches in his eel pens under the south walk killed; pays with a spell book and sends the player on to Sister Ondine.

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text: Hail, stranger. Giant Leeches got into my eel pens under the south walk. Fat ones. Go down there and kill every one of them. Then come back and I'll give you something worth reading.

reminder.speaker: Hobb
reminder.text: The leeches are still down there. Go on, get to it.

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: All dead? Good. Here, this spell book is yours. Now go and see Sister Ondine. She's been asking after you.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in Hobb's eel pens.

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: Paymaster Fennig wants the Imps driven out of the garrison's granary by the old mill.

offer.speaker: Paymaster Fennig
offer.text: Good day. I presume you are here about the notice on the gate. Imps have got into the garrison's granary, south of the castle by the old mill, and they are eating our winter stores! If you could drive them out, you'd save my position! I am held to account for every sack. There is a reward, of course.

reminder.speaker: Paymaster Fennig
reminder.text: Have you dealt with the Imps? Every hour I lose another sack!

completion.speaker: Paymaster Fennig
completion.text:
The Imps are gone? Splendid! The winter stores are saved!

As promised, here is your reward. A deserter left this bow behind when he ran off in the night. It is a perfectly good bow.

journal.text: Drive the Imps out of the garrison's granary.

variants.specifics: Vesk: Haskin, a fisherman bitten in the reed beds, wants the Giant Leeches there killed.

offer.speaker: Haskin
offer.text:
Kind sir! Help me, please! Look at my legs! I'm bitten all over!

Giant Leeches have come up out of the lake and into the reed beds, west of the village past the drying racks. Nobody can set a net out there now. They nearly had me for breakfast!

If you could clear them out, my boys and me could fish again. Do it and the spell book on my shelf is yours. I never could make heads or tails of it anyhow.

reminder.speaker: Haskin
reminder.text: Oh, my poor legs... Are those Leeches dead yet?

completion.speaker: Haskin
completion.text: The reeds are clear?! We can fish again! Bless you, kind sir! Here's the spell book, as I promised.

journal.text: Kill the Giant Leeches in the reed beds west of Vesk.

variants.specifics: Vorne: Gostrel the gardener, stung half to death, wants the Wasps' nest in his herb garden burned out; pays with a spell.

offer.speaker: Gostrel
offer.text:
Ow! Ow! Sir! Help me, get them off!

Wasps! Giant ones! Sarvok's Imps drove them down off Gallow Ridge and now they've built a nest in my herb garden, west of the Lyceum behind the old sundial.

Go and burn that nest out. Do it and I'll teach you a spell worth knowing.

reminder.speaker: Gostrel
reminder.text: Go on! They're still in there!

completion.speaker: Gostrel
completion.text: Burned it out? Ha! Good riddance! Here, the spell I promised you. Take it.

journal.text: Destroy the Wasp nest in Gostrel's herb garden.

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: Fennick, a fussy mapmaker, pays a bounty to be rid of the Imps nesting in the fort's chimney flues.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Ah. Good day. I take it you have read my notice? Imps! The wretched creatures have got into everything. They spill my ink and gnaw my maps, and the noise! I cannot work at all! I will pay a proper bounty to whoever rids Fort Kholm of them. Well? Will you do it?

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Still Imps! I hear them scratching in the chimney flues every night. Please hurry!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: Gone? Truly gone? Oh, what a relief! At last I can return to my maps. Here is your bounty, 100 gold pieces, and well earned.

journal.text: Rid Fort Kholm of the Imps and collect Fennick's bounty.

variants.specifics: Fornath: Overseer Krall wants the Ember Demons cleared out of the slag pits and hands over the iron key to the pit gate at once.

offer.speaker: Krall
offer.text:
Moreover, production in the slag pits has ceased entirely. Entirely! Ever since those Ember Demons came crawling up out of the vents.

These abominable creatures appeared the very night Gorvane's Ogres seized the Black Smeltery. My workers have been forced to abandon their posts and the pits are now wholly besieged. Irregardless of the danger, the pits must be reclaimed for Fornath.

Here, take this iron key, it will open the gate to the slag pits at the east end of town. Descend into the pits and eradicate every last one of these nefarious beasts. Report back to me when it is done.

reminder.speaker: Krall
reminder.text: Is it done? No? Then go, go!

completion.speaker: Krall
completion.text:
Splendid! The slag pits are liberated at last! My workers can return to their labors.

Take this shield as a token of my appreciation. You will have need of it, with Gorvane's Ogres still up on the mountain.

journal.text: Eradicate the Ember Demons in the slag pits.

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: Haddrick the Toll Keeper pays to have the bears driven from the beech wood that shuts the south road; he pays with a hunter's bow.

offer.speaker: Haddrick
offer.text: Good day. I take it you have come about the notice on my door? The bears in the beech wood, south of the crossroads past the old well, have become a public menace! Half the pigs in the hamlet are eaten and no cart will come up the south road. The Toll House is authorised to pay for the expungement of the bears. If you could drive them off, I would give you a very fine bow.

reminder.speaker: Haddrick
reminder.text: No carts, no tolls! Please do something about those bears.

completion.speaker: Haddrick
completion.text:
Splendid! Most splendid! The south road is open again, and the carts will be rolling by morning!

Here is the bow, as promised. A traveling hunter paid his toll with it last spring. He swore it once shot down a dragon. I don't believe a word of it, but it is a very good bow.

journal.text: Drive the bears out of the beech wood for Haddrick the Toll Keeper.

variants.specifics: Hestle: Hoskin, a goat farmer, wants the giant leeches out of his well house and pays with the key to his boat on the river.

offer.speaker: Hoskin
offer.text: Sir! Over here, quick! Giant leeches have crawled up out of my well house south of the farm, and they've had my goats! Here, drink this if they bite you. Now get in there and kill the lot of them.

reminder.speaker: Hoskin
reminder.text: Why are you still standing about? My goats are thirsty!

completion.speaker: Hoskin
completion.text: Gone? Truly gone? Oh, thank goodness! Here, take the key to my boat. It's tied up down at the river. Use it whenever you like.

journal.text: Kill the giant leeches in Hoskin's well house.
